components.name: Style Row
components.description: Single-choice row with an icon tile; selected is a quiet tint with a vermilion icon tile.
components.css: .ds-styles { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; background: #0b1520; padding: 12px; } .ds-style { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr auto; grid-template-areas: 'icon name meta' 'icon line key'; column-gap: 14px; align-items: baseline; text-align: left; width: 100%; min-height: 62px; padding: 10px 14px 10px 12px; background: rgb(200 220 235 / 0.05); color: #e8eef2; border: 1px solid rgb(200 220 235 / 0.16); border-radius: 6px; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-style:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4); } .ds-style[aria-checked='true'] { background: rgb(200 220 235 / 0.12); border-color: #e8eef2; } .ds-icon { grid-area: icon; align-self: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); } .ds-style[aria-checked='true'] .ds-icon { background: #ff6b4a; color: #1a0905; } .ds-name { grid-area: name; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-meta { grid-area: meta; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: rgb(232 238 242 / 0.64); } .ds-line { grid-area: line; font-size: 0.95rem; color: rgb(232 238 242 / 0.8); } .ds-style:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6b4a; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; padding: 28px 24px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(200 220 235 / 0.16); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(200 220 235 / 0.05); } .ds-lane { position: relative; display: flex; height: 40px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-g { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #05080b; font: 800 0.95rem Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; border-right: 1px solid #0b1520; } .ds-a { background: #7cc4ff; } .ds-b { background: #ffb454; } .ds-c { background: #b79cff; } .ds-d { background: #7fd1ae; } .ds-paper { height: 52px; overflow: visible; background-color: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(124 196 255 / 0.1) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(124 196 255 / 0.1) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(rgb(124 196 255 / 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(124 196 255 / 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 50px 52px, 50px 52px, 10px 13px, 10px 13px; } .ds-played { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 30%; bottom: 0; width: 42%; background: rgb(255 107 74 / 0.85); } .ds-head { position: absolute; left: 42%; top: -6px; bottom: -6px; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: #ff6b4a; } .ds-head b { position: absolute; top: -26px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 1px 7px; background: #ff6b4a; color: #0b1520; font: 500 0.78rem 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; border-radius: 2px; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
One synchronized instrument: footage, score and one shared timeline move together like a strip chart being drawn. The ground is ink-blue, near black at the page edge and a little lifted at the top. A single vermilion is the pen: it draws the played part of the loudness curve, the playhead and the Play button, and nothing else carries that colour. Four cool-to-warm pattern-group hues colour the data, always with a letter.

The recorder's ruled chart paper appears in exactly one place, behind the timeline lanes. Everywhere else the surface is quiet: translucent blue-grey panels, hairline rules, and large plain type. No glass, no starfield, no glow.

Density is moderate and predictable: large hit targets (56px transport, 44px minimum elsewhere), copy capped near 52-72ch, a two-column stage (480px footage column, fluid control column) that collapses to a single ordered column under 980px. Accessibility is the stated purpose: 3px vermilion focus rings, a letter on every group colour, reduced-motion support.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-blue gradient ground (#12202f to #0b1520 over 760px), pale blue-grey ink, one vermilion pen.
Panels 8px, buttons and rows 6px, chips 4px; soft tonal panels, hairline rules.
Figtree for everything spoken, JetBrains Mono for every numeral.
Four group hues, each paired with A-D; chart-paper grid only under timeline lanes.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks what plays, what has been played, what has focus and what progresses. Selection of a choice is not action: it is a quiet tint.

rules.name: The Letter Beside Color Rule
rules.body: A group hue never appears without its letter (A-D); colour is never the only cue.

rules.name: The Mono Is Numbers Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono carries timecodes, durations, step numerals and key hints; never prose.

rules.name: The Paper Under The Lanes Rule
rules.body: Ruled grid belongs to the timeline lanes and nowhere else; the group-blocks lane stays clear of it.

rules.name: The Hairline Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a Rule border or a Well first; a shadow is allowed only on the three surfaces named above.

dos: Do reserve vermilion for play, played, playhead, focus and progress.
Do pair every group colour with its letter and give it dark ink on bright fills.
Do mark selection with a quiet blue-grey tint and Ink border.
Do keep hit targets at 44px or more (56px transport).
Do use 3px vermilion focus rings with 3px offset (inset on the style list).
Do set every number in JetBrains Mono, tabular.
Do disable transitions and animation under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't add a second action colour, glass, glow or a starfield image.
Don't put chart-paper ruling on the page ground or panels; it is for timeline lanes only.
Don't fill a selected choice with white or vermilion; vermilion is not selection.
Don't use radii beyond 8px or below the role-based set above.
Don't set prose in JetBrains Mono.
